name: The Calculator
source: In this short sci-fi visual novel, you assume the role of Betty, an English housewife who goes out looking for her missing husband. Can she find him? and, most importantly, what will she find once she finds him?
translation: 在这部短篇科幻视觉小说中，你扮演贝蒂的角色，一位英国家庭主妇，外出寻找她失踪的丈夫。她能找到他吗？最重要的是，一旦找到他，她会发现什么？
